title: Great storage containers
text: Great storage containers. I love these storage containers. They dont have that smelly plastic oder. They are clear as glass so its easy to see what is inside. They snap together very easy and stay tight. They store inside each other to save space and stack nice when they are filled. Wash up very well.

product_metadata.title: Moon Castle 3 Pack Airtight Leak Proof Food Storage Containers
features: 100% BPA Free Food Grade Material: Worried about your old containers being unsafe? Never expose you or your loved ones to harmful chemicals ever again, and feel confident knowing that the Vallo glass containers have no harmful chemicals that could leech into your food. They are 100% BPA Free, Lead Free, & Phthalates Free.

Leakproof: 4-hinge locking system forms an airtight, which snap down tightly and create a very nice air seal that you just cannot get with a matte finish plastic flexible container. Never endure spilled food in your lunch bag again.
Crystal Clear: You can identificate the contents more easy, is time to put your labels away!

Bang For The Buck & Stackable Design: Just spend the sticker price, you can get 3 diffrents size containers! (S：2.5 Cup; M: 5 Cup; L:8 Cup). Space saving design makes efficient use of every inch of your home kitchen because they are stackable and nesting. Easily store food of all sizes!
Range Of Application: Suitable for refrigerator and freezer. If you use it in the microwave,please under 5 min, under 700 Watt, at least half-full container.
